We are thrilled to announce that the Nyanco Impact Thumbs Up Edition is now available as a beta version. This edition features a collection of AI images of cat girl thumbs up poses. To access the beta version, follow these steps:
[olist]
Locate the Nyanco Impact app in your Steam client.
Right-click the app and click the 'Properties...' menu.
Click on the 'BETAS' menu.
Select '👍Thumbs Up Edition❤️' from the beta list.
If the above procedure is completed normally, the app will be displayed as Nyanco Impact [beta] in the Steam client. To switch back to the original version, simply select 'None' from the beta list.

notes.title: New Game - Nyanco Channel
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33855818/306770ceb04a0aa72244c6db8d8f47183f8787ec.png

Intro
Welcome to Nyanco Channel! Whoever fights monsters should see to it that in the process that one does not become a monster. Moreover, should one gaze long enough into the abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you.

About This Game
Welcome to your new part time job at Nyanco Channel where many followers alike come to enjoy her video entertainment! Be aware though that there are hidden secrets on this channel that you don't know yet. While working your job for 3 days at Nyanco Channel from your small office you must remember to do many things. Things such as checking the CCTVs to watch for irregular activity, remembering to use your flashlight and opening and closing your door when the situation calls for it. You must stay safe and vigilant from 12 A.M. to 6 A.M. Can you survive three nights at Nyanco Channel?

Features

Anime/Doujin inspired art and themes
High replayabilty value through random events
Highly recommended for Nyanco Channel followers
Special ending rewards include illustrations of Nyanco-chan
Parodies of popular works you may or may not be familiar with


Game Engine
RPG Maker MV (by KADOKAWA / Degica)

Disclaimer
All characters in Nyanco Channel are fictional. Any resemblance to persons living or dead or the real world is purely coincidental.

Special Thanks
Alice, nashix, Holy Lightning, HaZE, Scott, ParanoX, Ruko, EinMeister, Azusa and You!

notes.title: [Event] Nyanco Project Thanks Contest
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35445608/5db8a0a43ddde48e1d86e0aa1b702b5239b352c9.jpg
Greetings fellow Nyancos! (ฅ'ω'ฅ)

Nyanco Project got over 11 million impressions! ヽ(=´▽`=)ﾉ
Thanks again for playing, and there will be a challenge contest!

1. Goal
Speedrun from 1st battle to last boss battle in normal mode.

2. Prize
Nyanco will send the 1st place winner any gift game(s) you want available on Steam for under $10. (If Steam Gift does not work due to exchange rate differences between countries, alternative gifts may be offered.)

3. Speed Run Conditions

(1) Contest participants must register their speedrun in the Nyanco Project Steam Community video section. (You may need a Youtube account. If you are a player from countries where Youtube is not available, you can submit your speedrun video by email or discord to Nyanco Channel. The video you sent will be registered directly in the Nyanco Project Steam Community Video Section by Nyanco, without any editing)

(2) A total of 9 battles from the first battle to the final boss battle are currently available on Nyanco Project. That means your speedrun video should include these 9 anime girl battles.

(3) Speedrun videos can only contain your total battles process. To shorten the speedrun time, the option to cut some of your battle walkthrough or edit the game speed is not allowed. In short, you must have an unedited speedrun of all 9 battles, with videos submitted to the Nyanco Project Steam Community.

(4) The final winner will be announced on September 1st. (Thank you for all participating. Videos from Speedrun winners can be found here: 1st place, 2nd place, 3rd place)

Have your happy memories with anime girls in Nyanco Project ヽ(=^･ω･^=)丿
